title: Gutter-Bell Mite
text: A palm-sized brass mite clings to a signal gutter, ringing a tiny alarm whenever shadows move.
flavor: A small bell can still wake the wrong thing.

defeatReward.text: You mute the mite before the alarm spreads down the gutter.

imagePrompt: A tiny brass insect-like bell mite on a rain-dark signal gutter, glowing blue eye-lens, gothic industrial street detail, cute but unsettling
